verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs show a fully local CLI workflow (pip/docker install, `meltano init`, `meltano add` for extractors/loaders, `meltano run`, `meltano config test`) that lets an engineer build and test a pipeline on their own machine before deploying it (e.g., via Docker or Airflow) to production. However, there is no explicit mention of a 'lightweight destination' (e.g., target-jsonl/sqlite/duckdb) or of a dev/staging environment concept for pre-production testing. missing for 10: explicit lightweight/dev destination guidance, environment-separation (dev vs prod) documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of local testing workflow.
